Visit note | 2025-11-29 12:30 PM | Dr. Farhana Kabir, General Medicine | Patient: Sohel Haque, 23, male. Mr. Haque reports a faint rash on his arms accompanied by severe aching in his bones and muscles. He mentions that his illness started during the monsoon after mosquitoes bred in water tanks near Mymensingh. He works as a delivery rider. He has no chronic comorbidity. He denies bleeding manifestations, cough, or sore throat. Examination shows: platelet count 102000 per microlitre, temperature 101.4°F, BP 136/72 mmHg, pulse 98 bpm, weight 93 kg. Chest is clear and abdomen is soft. Assessment: Dengue fever. Plan: a prescription was issued today. He was advised to drink at least three litres of fluid a day, avoid ibuprofen and aspirin, repeat the platelet count in 48 hours, and go to hospital at once for bleeding gums, black stools, or severe belly pain. Follow-up in 48 hours with a repeat platelet count.

Visit note | 2025-11-29 12:30 PM | Dr. Rokeya Khatun, Obstetrics and Gynecology | Patient: Sadia Hossain, 59, female. Mrs. Hossain presents complaining of burning sensation when passing urine and a lower belly ache. She notes that her symptoms started after a trip to Mymensingh. She works as an accountant. She has no known comorbidity. She denies flank pain, fever chills, or vaginal discharge. On examination: temperature 100.0°F, BP 121/78 mmHg, pulse 85 bpm, weight 64 kg. Abdomen is soft with mild suprapubic tenderness; renal angles are non-tender. Assessment: Uncomplicated urinary tract infection. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to drink at least two litres of water daily and not to hold urine for long. Follow-up in 1 week if symptoms continue.

Visit note | 2025-11-29 03:00 PM | Dr. Rafiqul Islam, Cardiology | Patient: Jubayer Karim, 64, male. Mr. Karim attends for a review of his ongoing condition, reporting that he has been getting tired easily, experiencing dizzy spells, and feeling an irregular fast heartbeat. He states these troubles started after a sleepless night travelling to Mirpur. He is a retired civil servant. He has no chronic comorbidity. He denies chest pain or shortness of breath at rest. On examination: pulse 138 bpm and irregular, BP 112/74 mmHg, weight 87 kg. Heart sounds are irregularly irregular with no added murmurs; lung fields are clear. Assessment: Atrial fibrillation. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to limit tea and coffee, avoid alcohol, and report any fainting at once. Follow-up in 2 weeks with an ECG and kidney function tests.

Visit note | 2025-11-29 04:00 PM | Dr. Habibur Rahman, Orthopedics | Patient: Rokeya Hossain, 45, female.
